# Validation: reported events against the radar map

<!-- Generated by content/build_validation_table.py from data/derived/validation.csv and
     data/reference/events.geojson. Do not edit by hand; re-run the script. -->

We collected 18 reported events, each with a linked source. Of the 10 reported floods that radar could observe, 4 had a detection nearby; of the 4 landslides, 2.

"Detected" means a radar detection lies within the distance the report's location allows. "Could not check" means the radar had no fair chance: the reason is given.
